concepts.title: Classifier-Free Guidance
concepts.content: Classifier-free guidance combines conditional and unconditional model predictions. A common formulation is ε̂ = ε_uncond + s(ε_cond − ε_uncond), where s controls guidance strength. Higher guidance often improves prompt adherence but can reduce diversity or introduce artifacts.
concepts.image_prompt: Draw two denoiser prediction paths, one labeled unconditional prediction and one labeled text-conditioned prediction. Show their difference being scaled by guidance strength s, then added to the unconditional prediction. Label the final guided prediction. Add a compact trade-off note: stronger guidance can improve adherence but may cause artifacts or reduced diversity.

concepts.title: Text Encoder and Cross-Attention
concepts.content: A text encoder maps a prompt into token-level embeddings. In cross-attention, image or latent features provide queries, while text embeddings provide keys and values; this lets spatial features select relevant prompt tokens.
